system.description: Patrolians are small, aquatic beings with finned extremities and large eyes. Their skin is bright, colored in pastel shades of blues, greens, and pinks, and while clumsy and plodding on the land, they are quite graceful in the water. Much like the fellow aquatic Mon Calamari, Patrolians are quite taken with computer systems and shipbuilding, seeking to emulate the Mon Calamari's path toward integration with the rest of the galaxy.
